column4: dialect-gated: cleat#2243 added mysql and mysql_read_committed subtests to cleat#2233's live-interleaving race test for sendWebhook, mirroring cleat#2242's identical addition to webhookingest's version of this test -- so it now has postgres, mysql, mysql_read_committed and mssql_rcsi_on subtests. mysql and mysql_read_committed both need CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL (the latter forces transaction_isolation=READ-COMMITTED on the same DSN, docs/reference/database-backends.md's recommended setting); mssql_rcsi_on needs CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL (forces READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT on in a private database, notificationsPrivateRCSIDatabase). All three explicitly t.Skip (not the loop-over-testutil.NewPluginTestBackends-with-continue shape, which silently no-ops with zero skip events instead -- cleat-review's nit on cleat#2242, applied here too). ci.yml's test-go/plugins job provides only PostgreSQL (CLEAT_TEST_DB), so all three skip there and postgres runs. Measured by name: go test ./plugins/notifications/... -run TestASendWebhookRacingAnOpenDeleteTransactionIsBlocked -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL unset reports exactly these three, 3 -- not 1.
